The committee recommended approval and rated the overall quality of the proposed institute as high value to the University of Rhode Island.
Committee Comments The proposal is well organized and comprehensive, with a clear articulation of collaborators, planned activities, and strong potential for impactful research.
The institute has presented a thoughtful and feasible plan for securing external funding, including philanthropic support.
Notably, Dr.
Parente has a demonstrated record of obtaining external funding.

The proposal was accompanied by a highly enthusiastic and supportive letter from College of Health Sciences Dean Patrick Vivier.
Committee Considerations While the proposed CHILD Institute aligns more closely with the University’s current definition of a “Center” rather than an “Institute,” the committee voted to recommend approval based on its strong potential for cross-college collaboration, including sustained and meaningful collaboration with the College of Nursing.
Recommendation Approve as proposed.
